ui_click.description: Soft low-volume UI tap. Source: Kenney Interface Sounds CC0 click_001.

ui_error.description: Polite invalid-action knock/drop. Source: Kenney Interface Sounds CC0 drop_001.

cast.description: Soft cast/line rustle. Source: 202 More Sound Effects CC0 Cloth_05.

bobber_splash.description: Small bobber water entry. Source: 40 CC0 water/splash/slime SFX splash_09.

bite.description: Small bite/ripple cue. Source: 40 CC0 water/splash/slime SFX bubble_02.

catch_common.description: Gentle common catch water lift. Source: 40 CC0 water/splash/slime SFX splash_06.

catch_rare.description: Rare catch water lift plus soft confirmation. Sources: water splash_01 and Kenney confirmation_001 CC0.

coin.description: Soft pouch coin Foley. Source: 202 More Sound Effects CC0 Money_07.

upgrade.description: Quiet confirmation for upgrades. Source: Kenney Interface Sounds CC0 confirmation_001.

ambience_water_loop.description: Soft looping water ambience. Source: 40 CC0 water/splash/slime SFX loop_water_03.

amb_stream_loop.description: Seamless mountain-stream/riffle bed. Source: Freesound #433589 'jackthemurray' stream-river-water-up-close (via Wikimedia Commons), CC0.

amb_birds_day.description: Quiet daytime woodland birdsong bed. Source: OpenGameArt 'Ambient Bird Sounds' by isaiah658, CC0.

amb_wind_loop.description: Open-air wind bed. Source: OpenGameArt 'wind1' open-air wind, CC0.

amb_night_insects.description: Warm-night cricket bed. Source: OpenGameArt 'Crickets ambient noise (loopable)', CC0.

amb_waves_loop.description: Ocean swell bed (rolling surf). Source: OpenGameArt 'Beach Ocean Waves' by jasinski (alkai beach), CC0.

amb_gulls_day.description: Coastal gull bed (sparse calls). Source: OpenGameArt 'Solo Seagull Sound Effects' (Seagull Ambient), CC0.

amb_cave_drip.description: Cavern-pool water-drip bed. Source: OpenGameArt 'Dripping water loop' (atmosbasement), CC0.

sfx_new_species.description: Warm three-note harp lift for a first-ever species. Synthesized (Karplus-Strong), public domain.

sfx_record.description: Four-note rise with octave-below root — personal best weight. Synthesized, public domain.

sfx_achievement.description: Open fifth plus a single glass chime — dignified achievement mark. Synthesized, public domain.

sfx_focus_reward.description: Scattered wind chime for the focus reward. Deliberately near-inaudible. Synthesized, public domain.

sfx_competition_win.description: Weekly giant-fish contest gold. Full rise over a low root. Synthesized, public domain.

sfx_spot_unlock.description: Wide airy rise for unlocking a new fishing spot. Synthesized, public domain.

sfx_reel_tension.description: Bite->catch tension loop: synthesized bowed swell (public domain) under a lowpassed real line-creak. Creak source: Wikimedia Commons 'Assorted creaking noises of office chair' (public domain) — no free fishing-line recording exists.

bgm_day.description: Main loop: shimmering piano, low pulses, gentle pads, no percussion. Source: OpenGameArt 'First Light Particles' by Yoiyami, CC0.

bgm_night.description: Night variation: sparse ambience, author states 'no real melody or focus'. Source: OpenGameArt 'Contemplation' by Joth, CC0.

catch_good.description: Good-quality catch: water lift with a very faint confirmation. Sources: OGA 40 CC0 water/splash/slime splash_09 + Kenney Interface Sounds confirmation_002 (kenney.nl, CC0).

catch_epic.description: Rainbow / legendary catch: big water lift, a thrashing fish, and a five-note rise with shimmer tail. Sources: OGA 40 CC0 water/splash/slime splash_01 + Wikimedia Commons 'Bathtub water splashes' (public domain) + synthesized tail (tools/synth_feedback_sfx.py).

sfx_cat_steal.description: The cat steals a fish: one soft inquisitive meow, then a small paw splash. Sources: Wikimedia Commons 'Meow of a Siamese cat' by freemaster2 (CC0) + OGA 40 CC0 water/splash/slime splash_09. The meow source clips on ~0.05% of samples; harmless after normalisation to peak 0.26.

sfx_fish_struggle.description: A big fish thrashing on the line, layered under the bite of tier-3+ catches. Source: Wikimedia Commons 'Bathtub water splashes' (public domain), loudest 1.1 s window, lowpassed to sit inside the watercolour palette.

sfx_event_appear.description: Two soft notes and a chime — a random event has appeared. Synthesized, public domain.
